prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: lime green. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them. Every cutout is matte paper reflecting only the room light, with a plain blank face: coin rims, document faces, screens and vehicle sides carry no lettering, numerals or marks.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons, tape, rubber stamps, string and pins, stencilled arrows, paper bar charts, stacked sheets, grid paper, torn strips, hole-punched tags, paper clips, in cream, black, pale yellow or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture and print dots.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip: one line, no wider than a third of the frame width, with safe margins, the chip sitting clear of the subjects. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw. When the beat marks a hero number, that number alone may be printed larger, up to half the frame width.
8. Compositions vary in scale from beat to beat: some show one oversized subject filling the frame, some a small subject alone on open ground, some several elements arranged as a diagram.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: lime green.
Subjects: a paper hand; a document.
Opens on the calendar strip, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the calendar strip folds into a single document; a paper hand enters and rests on it.
Ends holding on the resting hand.
This composition is small-scale: a single subject sits alone on open ground.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "SHOW ROI".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "SHOW ROI". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a 2D motion design style, photographed as a flat lay under soft room lighting with a consistent light source from the upper left. <Picture 1> serves as the first frame, featuring a pink background with several black-and-white halftone coin cutouts with rough white torn edges and a cream paper chip with the text "UNEVEN ADOPTION". Immediately upon the start of the video, the camera remains in a Static Shot as the existing composition quickly clears: the cream chip and the halftone coins slide off-frame to the left and right with fast, snappy motion. Simultaneously, the background ground transforms into a single, unbroken block of matte lime green paper. A long, thin strip of white grid paper—a calendar strip—which was partially visible, rapidly folds and compresses itself into a single, rectangular blank document cutout. This document is a black-and-white halftone photograph of a plain, unmarked page with rough white torn-paper edges, casting a small soft shadow toward the bottom right. At 00:01.500, a new cream-colored paper chip enters the upper third of the frame from the top, landing with a slight overshoot to display the bold, black, extra-bold sans-serif text "SHOW ROI" in a clean, legible, and stable print. Simultaneously, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an anonymous paper hand, also featuring rough white torn edges, slides in quickly from the right side of the frame. The hand moves with a fast, mechanical snap and comes to a stable rest, its palm and fingers pressing down onto the blank document. The final two seconds of the video hold this small-scale composition—the hand resting on the document centered on the lime green ground—with a very subtle, rhythmic pulsing loop of the elements to maintain a sense of life.

overall_soundscape: The audio consists of crisp, tactile foley sounds. A sharp, sliding paper friction sound occurs as the initial elements clear, followed by a quick, rhythmic series of paper-folding snaps as the strip transforms into a document. A distinct, light "slap" sound punctuates the landing of the paper hand on the document, accompanied by a short, adhesive tape-like peel sound.
